decisions.reason: Routing D+ and D- through J_PWR_SIGNAL does not change the selected USB-C connector, its data-line support, or its sourceability requirements.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording J_PWR_SIGNAL pins 5 and 6 as D+ and D-, so no additional or edited Event is required.
The USB routing change concerns J_PWR_SIGNAL pins 5 and 6; it does not alter the boost output route or the 5V_EN route, which are already independently captured from the same message.
The assignment of USB data lines to connector pins does not change I2C cable length, bus speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
The electrical pin assignment does not change connector orientation, mechanical placement, mounting-hole clearance, or battery-cable accessibility.
The USB interboard route does not affect the SK6812 LED family or its GPIO13 data interface.
J_PWR_SIGNAL is an interboard signal connector and does not change the separate J_BAT connector family, part number, pin count, or battery pin functions.
The USB data-line routing does not alter the J_BAT NTC terminal or the battery thermal-protection behavior.
The interboard USB pin assignment does not change charge-status display through the SK6812 chain on GPIO13.
